hero.description: Macro photography of an elegant medical concept: a glowing delicate sine wave representing health, resting on a textured natural stone surface. Soft daylight, shallow depth of field, earthy tones of beige and sage green. Use for the Hero Section visual or Background imagery in the About section.

specific_design_instructions: Run: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` and use Phosphor Icons (Duotone weight) for a high-end, friendly SaaS feel. Do not use Lucide.
Dashboard must avoid 'glassmorphism' for data clarity. Stick to Flat Solid surfaces with max 8px border-radius (`rounded-lg`).
Marketing page should utilize heavy padding (e.g., py-32) and asymmetric bento grids (grid-cols-12) to create breathing room.
Hero section must not use a fully dark overlay. Use a subtle gradient overlay or position text in negative space to let the generated health sine wave image shine.

The Daily Tracker (Spreadsheet-style) must feature sticky headers and inline editing UI with a clean, un-bordered look inside cells, only separated by horizontal lines (border-b). Use dense padding in tables.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, links, and forms.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Outfit' for all headings. Use 'Inter' or 'Work Sans' for Body and tabular data.
Avoid typical bright medical blue or sterile white. Stick to the Earthy Palette (stone, deep green, terracotta) to provide warmth and reduce patient anxiety.
Charts (Recharts) must use the specific chart_colors array provided. No generic defaults.
Forms & Inputs: Use Shadcn components for complex interactions but heavily customize them with the soft stone backgrounds and deep green focus rings.
Navigation: Header must have a solid or frosted background. Never use a transparent header directly over hero images without proper scrim/backdrop-blur.
